answer: Give every new agent a fresh, time-boxed practical task drawn from a hidden set, like tending one row of an orchard rather than claiming the whole ridge at once. Each task takes about twenty minutes of real, skilled work and cannot be copied across identities because the inputs differ per agent. A sudden gale of identical submissions is rejected automatically, and a verifier replays each solution against hidden ground truth before any reward is granted, so running a hundred clones costs a hundred separate skilled sessions.
